subject: pol-dy
title: POL.DY.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 245 (CMOA(II)-3). POL-DY (political dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY (information dynamics), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). From INFO-DY: AFL (affinity alignment). From SPT-DY: RIT-DY (ritual dynamics). From CULT-INFO-DY: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AFL: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From AF-DY: INFO-DE (information degrees). From SOC-RT-DY: PART (participation).
